maddeler.e: كَرْزَن or كِرْزِن • (karzan or kirzin) m (plural كَرَازِن (karāzin))
maddeler.t: The axe from Aramaic גרזנא (*garzənā), and the headdress separately from Persian گرزن (garzan, “crown”). For the sound change /n/ → /m/ consider مِيجَم (mījam) and إِبْزِيم (ʔibzīm).
